```yaml
name: Release

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js 18
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 18
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build production artifacts
        run: npm run build

      - name: Validate build artifacts
        run: |
          echo "Checking build artifacts in dist/"
          if [ ! -d dist ]; then
            echo "::error::dist/ directory not found"
            exit 1
          fi
          bad_files=$(find dist -type f -size 0)
          if [ -n "$bad_files" ]; then
            echo "::error::The following files are empty:"
            echo "$bad_files"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "All artifacts are present and non‑empty."

      - name: Generate timestamped tag
        run: |
          TAG=$(date +%Y.%m.%d-%H%M%S)
          echo "TAG=$TAG" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "Generated tag: $TAG"

      - name: Create GitHub release
        uses: actions/create-release@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ env.TAG }}
          release_name: Release ${{ env.TAG }}
          draft: false
          prerelease: false

      - name: Upload release assets
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          echo "Uploading assets for tag ${{ env.TAG }}"
          for asset in $(find dist -type f); do
            echo "Uploading $asset"
            gh release upload ${{ env.TAG }} "$asset" --repo $GITHUB_REPOSITORY
          done
```
